schema:
CREATE TABLE models (
            model_id integer primary key,
            first_seen_at text not null,
            first_seen_date text not null,
            last_seen_at text not null,
            name text,
            model_type text not null,
            creator_username text,
            nsfw integer,
            mode text,
            initial_base_model_raw text,
            raw_json text
        )

CREATE TABLE model_versions (
            version_id integer primary key,
            model_id integer not null,
            first_seen_at text not null,
            first_seen_date text not null,
            last_seen_at text not null,
            created_at text,
            version_name text,
            model_type text not null,
            base_model_raw text,
            raw_json text, published_at text,
            foreign key(model_id) references models(model_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE daily_counts (
            observed_date text not null,
            model_type text not null,
            base_model_raw text not null,
            new_version_count integer not null,
            new_model_count integer not null,
            active_total integer,
            collected_at text not null,
            primary key(observed_date, model_type, base_model_raw)
        )

CREATE TABLE collection_runs (
            run_id text primary key,
            started_at text not null,
            finished_at text,
            observed_date text not null,
            status text not null,
            pages_fetched integer default 0,
            models_seen integer default 0,
            versions_seen integer default 0,
            error_message text
        , coverage_started_at text, coverage_finished_at text, known_version_stop integer, execution_status text)

CREATE TABLE collection_errors (
            id integer primary key autoincrement,
            observed_at text not null,
            observed_date text not null,
            scope text not null,
            url text,
            http_status integer,
            message text not null
        , run_id text)

CREATE TABLE collection_run_types (
            run_id text not null, model_type text not null, query_json text not null,
            query_kind text not null default 'normal',
            stop_reason text not null, pages_fetched integer not null,
            models_seen integer not null, versions_seen integer not null,
            new_models integer not null, new_versions integer not null,
            error_count integer not null, requested_started_at text,
            requested_finished_at text, fetch_finished_at text not null,
            coverage_status text not null,
            primary key(run_id, model_type, query_json),
            foreign key(run_id) references collection_runs(run_id))

CREATE TABLE active_total_history (
            observed_at text not null, model_type text not null,
            base_model_raw text not null, active_total integer not null,
            source_url text, run_id text,
            primary key(observed_at, model_type, base_model_raw))

CREATE TABLE migration_audit (
            schema_version integer primary key, applied_at text not null,
            inferred_first_seen_dates integer not null default 0)
limitations: LoRA and Checkpoint supply are different product units from posted image content.
All retained per-type coverage rows are partial; absent coverage is not a verified zero.
created_at is missing; published_at is the usable publication field.
First-seen/last-seen fields do not provide historical per-version engagement snapshots.
No economic-person account mapping, recommendation share, cost shock or known ranking alpha.
